result.summary: The page is mostly functional and legible. Minor layout issues include a carousel item clipped at the right edge and vertical content overlapping the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, leaving the third restaurant card and its text clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or reduce card width so the partially visible card is clearly intended as a scrollable affordance.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, which overlays the second restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the navigation bar height so content can scroll fully clear of the overlay.
